tools.name: lessonspace_list_sessions
tools.description: List the organisation's sessions (a session is one meeting held in a space): name, uuid, start/end time, space, participants (name, email, role), guests, billable seconds, tags, summary and recording state. Filter by time, duration, participant, space, launch id or tags. Newest first as Lessonspace

tools.name: lessonspace_get_session
tools.description: One session by uuid, with its space, participants, guests, tags, summary and recording state. GET /organisations/sessions/{session}/.

tools.name: lessonspace_get_session_recording
tools.description: The playback URL of a session's recording. status 'ready' = the URL works now; 'preparing' = Lessonspace is still creating it (ask again in a minute); 'no_recording' = recording was disabled, so none exists. The URL is an access link: give it only to someone entitled to watch the recording. GET /org

tools.name: lessonspace_get_session_transcript
tools.description: A signed download URL for a session's transcript. Only works if transcription was switched on for the session (launch with transcribe=true). The URL is an access link: give it only to someone entitled to read the transcript. GET /organisations/sessions/{session}/transcript/.

tools.name: lessonspace_update_session
tools.description: WRITE: rename a session and optionally set who may watch its recording (a list of participant, admin, teacher, student; an empty list falls back to the organisation policy). The name is always sent (Lessonspace requires it). PATCH /organisations/sessions/{session}/.

tools.name: lessonspace_list_spaces
tools.description: List the organisation's spaces (persistent rooms): id, name, slug, alias, url, tags, lock state, region and recording/transcription settings. The url of a space is a way in; treat it as sensitive. GET /organisations/spaces/.

tools.name: lessonspace_list_space_sessions
tools.description: Sessions held in one space, with the join/leave log (who joined, left or went idle, and when) and the users connected now. Same filters as lessonspace_list_sessions. GET /spaces/{space}/sessions/.

tools.name: lessonspace_launch_space
tools.description: WRITE: create a space, or reuse the one with the same `id`, and get a join link (client_url) for one participant. tools.name: lessonspace_list_users
tools.description: List the organisation's users: Lessonspace user id, name, email, role (teacher, student, admin), active state and external id. Names and emails are personal data. GET /organisations/users/.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "lessonspace_launch_space" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lessonspace_list_sessions, lessonspace_get_session_recording, lessonspace_get_session_transcript, lessonspace_list_spaces, lessonspace_launch_space, lessonspace_list_users · Private data: lessonspace_launch_space · Public sink: lessonspace_list_sessions, lessonspace_launch_space, lessonspace_list_users.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lessonspace_list_sessions, lessonspace_get_session_recording, lessonspace_get_session_transcript, lessonspace_list_spaces, lessonspace_launch_space, lessonspace_list_users · Private data: lessonspace_launch_space · Public sink: lessonspace_list_sessions, lessonspace_launch_space, lessonspace_list_users

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
